fusions.name: Parting Barb
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health: a barbed sting that tears free of you, dealing 8 poison damage and leaving the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Alarm Scent
fusions.desc: Releases an alarm scent that deals 11 poison damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Thousand Small Points
fusions.desc: Calls up a swarm for 12 seconds that stings an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second, each sting with a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Nectar Run
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you are healed for 3% of your maximum health per stack (18% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
